goal: Adjudicate the positive entitlement claimed for reliable belief-independent generation and justified-input historical transmission without assuming privileged access. Defend relevant process individuation, reliability, evidence-defeater handling and an adequate available-process counterfactual, against internalist demand for non-question-begging entitlement and holistic or infinitist replacements.
reason: Existing introspection and regress controls do not determine actual justificatory adequacy. Goldman himself distinguishes conditional reliability, uncertain process generality and later defeater revisions; his proposal must not be replaced by a reliability-alone slogan.
